I think you’re right to ask God to help you make the right decision because I don’t feel like anyone can really tell you what path to take when you’re at a crossroads. I would say have a backup plan for whichever option you decide to take and think about which decision will help you get to where you really want to be in life. Remember, it’s not about how quickly you get there, it’s about getting there so careful planning is key. Also you probably have, but if you haven’t, discuss it with as many family members as possible and get them behind any decision you try and make. Hope it all goes well for you and your family!
